name: Helicone
summary: Open-source AI gateway and LLM observability platform for tracing requests, with a free Hobby cloud tier and usage-based paid plans.
description: Open-source AI gateway and LLM observability platform for tracing requests, with a free Hobby cloud tier and usage-based paid plans.

pricing.details: Hobby Free — 10,000 free requests/month, 1 GB storage, 1 seat and 1 organization. Pro 71 €/month (7-day free trial) — everything in Hobby, unlimited seats, alerts and reports, HQL, usage-based pricing applies (10k requests free then usage-based). Team 723 €/month (7-day free trial) — everything in Pro, 5 organizations, SOC 2 and HIPAA, dedicated Slack, usage-based pricing applies. Enterprise is contact sales (custom MSA, SAML SSO, on-prem). An on-page calculator gives example usage totals; those examples are illustrative and were not copied as list prices. Official credits for startups (under 2 years old and 4,524,068 € in funding) and a 90 € credit for open-source companies in the first year are stated discounts, not base prices.
pricing.label: Freemium
